Definition: apparently a primary word (compare "daughter"); a female child, or (by Hebraism) descendant (or inhabitant):--daughter.
BiblicalUsage: In the Bible, thygátēr means a daughter. In Matthew 9:18, My daughter is even now dead, and it appears again in Mark 5:34.
TheologicalSignificance: A father pleading for his dead daughter and a woman healed by touching a hem both tell me Jesus answers desperate, reaching faith.
